data.statement: Do different declared executed recipe revisions explain the reported A/B assay difference in the supplied FERM-101 records, and what remains unresolved?
data.interpretation_limit: No claim of physical comparability, yield, kinetics, causation, optimum or current plant truth.

records.title: Proposed recipe-revision explanation
records.summary: An untested authored hypothesis; it is not a source observation.
known_unknowns: Installed execution, undeclared changes, feed mapping, assay reliability and process mechanisms remain unverified.

data.statement: Hypothesis: different declared executed recipe revisions for A and B account for the reported assay difference. This explanation has not yet been checked in this packet.
data.interpretation_limit: A record-level check can disconfirm the declared-revision explanation, but cannot establish actual process identity or another cause.

records.title: Plan a falsifiable records check
records.summary: Template only; no result or process intervention has been recorded.

data.purpose: Compare exact batch and reported-executed recipe identities/revisions for A and B at the declared cutoff, using the selected join/source snapshots.

steps.description: Run the existing join --check with the operator-selected manifest and saved join. Retain actual status, code/source selection and raw report identity before citing it.
steps.draft_output: A dated recorded check, or an unresolved/missing-basis note. A prior successful check is not permanent currency.

steps.description: Inspect A-batch/B-batch and A-recipe/B-recipe, including namespace, recipe_id, recipe_revision, execution_basis and source_revision. If both selected records declare the same recipe revision, the different-declared-revision explanation fails on those records. If any field is unavailable, unqualified or not available as of the cutoff, leave the check unresolved.
steps.draft_output: A source-cited record-check claim distinct from the original hypothesis; never an equipment or process-test outcome.

steps.description: Retain supporting and contradicting records and unresolved alternatives. Propose further source review without accepting a recipe, changing operations or assigning an authority that is not supplied.
steps.draft_output: A proposed disposition and unassigned next source/reviewer request, with links to the actual check and descriptive observations.

stop_or_review_conditions: Missing, stale or mismatched selected basis; unknown record association, units, quality or availability.
No safe process experiment, equipment change or operating action is authorized by this packet.

deliverables: Exact source/report locators and revision pins
Original hypothesis, falsifier, actual record check and limited proposed disposition
Unresolved alternatives and next required source/reviewer
review_handoff.acceptance: Source-bound reconstruction and retention only. Generic knowledge capture does not validate scientific roles, source meaning, causal reasoning or company approval.

records.title: Alternatives remain unresolved
records.summary: Do not substitute a rejected explanation with an untested causal story.

data.statement: Potential differences in actual feed delivery, substrate/composition, sampling and assay, volume basis, mapping, execution or biology remain unresolved. These are questions for qualified source review, not asserted causes.
data.interpretation_limit: The supplied descriptive comparison does not establish consumed substrate, product mass, yield, kinetics, a better recipe or the effect of an intervention.

records.title: Review one explanation without losing its contradiction
records.summary: Read the proposed hypothesis and planned check before adding source-bound observations or a disposition.
